days.title: What Makes a Family
days.learning_objective: Families come in many forms and provide support and belonging.
learning_objectives: Define empathy and differentiate it from sympathy.
Identify emotional cues in others through facial expressions and body language.
Practice active listening and perspective-taking in simulated scenarios.

days.title: How We Understand Each Other
days.learning_objective: Understanding how we understand each other helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Identify and differentiate between verbal and non-verbal communication.
Practice active listening skills to improve understanding and empathy.
Demonstrate clear and concise communication in various scenarios.

days.title: Why Humans Have Language
days.learning_objective: Language allows humans to share complex ideas.
learning_objectives: Define language and its primary functions.
Identify different forms of language, including verbal and non-verbal communication.
Explain how language facilitates the transmission of knowledge and culture across generations.

days.title: When Humans Started Writing
days.learning_objective: Understanding when humans started writing shaped history and our lives.
learning_objectives: Identify the importance of writing for preserving knowledge and history.
Apply basic writing techniques to create clear and engaging sentences.
Develop a short story or essay that effectively conveys a message.

days.title: What Reading Does to Your Brain
days.learning_objective: Reading exercises the brain and builds knowledge.
learning_objectives: Identify the main characters and setting in a story.
Summarize the plot of a short story in their own words.
Describe how a character's actions affect the story's outcome.

days.title: Why Numbers Were Invented
days.learning_objective: Understanding why numbers were invented matters to us and the world.
learning_objectives: Count objects to 20 with accuracy.
Identify and write numbers from 0 to 20.
Compare quantities using terms like 'more,' 'less,' and 'equal to'.

days.title: How Adding Works
days.learning_objective: Understanding how adding works helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to add two single-digit numbers with sums up to 10.
Students will be able to represent addition using objects, drawings, and equations.
Students will be able to solve simple word problems involving addition.

days.title: Taking Things Away
days.learning_objective: Taking Things Away is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to define subtraction as finding the difference between two numbers.
Students will be able to solve subtraction problems with numbers up to 20 using various strategies (counting back, number lines).
Students will be able to apply subtraction to solve simple real-world problems.

days.title: The Shortcut for Repeated Adding
days.learning_objective: Multiplication is repeated addition that saves time.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to define multiplication as repeated addition.
Students will be able to solve multiplication problems with single-digit factors.
Students will be able to apply multiplication to solve simple word problems.

days.title: Splitting Things Fairly
days.learning_objective: Division distributes quantities equally among groups.
learning_objectives: Define division as the process of splitting into equal groups.
Solve basic division problems using manipulatives and visual aids.
Apply division to real-world scenarios involving sharing and grouping.

days.title: Parts of a Whole
days.learning_objective: Fractions represent parts of a whole.
learning_objectives: Identify key features of Ancient Egyptian civilization, including its geography and social structure.
Explain the purpose and construction methods of the pyramids.
Describe the role of pharaohs and their significance in Egyptian society.

days.title: Another Way to Write Fractions
days.learning_objective: Decimals express fractions using powers of ten.
learning_objectives: Identify key figures and events in Ancient Greek history.
Explain the principles of democracy as developed in Ancient Greece.
Summarize the main ideas of prominent Greek philosophers.

days.title: Out of a Hundred
days.learning_objective: Out of a Hundred is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify key figures and events in Ancient Roman history.
Describe the structure of Roman society and government.
Explain the impact of Roman innovations on modern life.

days.title: How We Measure Things
days.learning_objective: Measurement uses standard units to quantify the world.
learning_objectives: Identify the three major inventions attributed to Ancient China: paper, gunpowder, and the compass.
Explain how each invention (paper, gunpowder, compass) impacted ancient Chinese society and its development.
Describe the lasting influence of these Chinese inventions on the modern world.

days.title: The Math of Shapes
days.learning_objective: Math of Shapes plays an important role in how the world works.
learning_objectives: Identify key regions connected by the Silk Road.
Explain the significance of goods and ideas exchanged along the Silk Road.
Analyze the impact of the Silk Road on cultural diffusion and globalization.

days.title: How Maps Bend Reality
days.learning_objective: Understanding how maps bend reality helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Identify key features of Viking longships and explain their importance.
Describe Viking navigation techniques and their limitations.
Analyze the impact of Viking exploration on different regions of the world.

days.title: How We Know Which Way
days.learning_objective: Navigation tools and landmarks help us find our way.
learning_objectives: Identify the main features and purpose of a medieval castle.
Describe how castles protected communities during the medieval period.
Explain daily life within a medieval castle, including roles and responsibilities.

days.title: Finding Your Way
days.learning_objective: Finding Your Way is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify key figures and their contributions during the Renaissance.
Explain the shift from medieval to Renaissance thought and culture.
Analyze the impact of the Renaissance on art, science, and society.

days.title: How We Track Time
days.learning_objective: Time passes at a constant rate, yet feels different in different moments.
learning_objectives: Identify key historical figures and expeditions in exploration.
Analyze the motivations and consequences of exploration throughout history.
Connect exploration to advancements in science, technology, and global understanding.

days.title: Why Clocks Exist
days.learning_objective: Understanding why clocks exist matters to us and the world.
learning_objectives: Define 'invention' and differentiate it from 'discovery'.
Identify the key steps in the invention process.
Explain how inventions have impacted society and culture.
Brainstorm and develop a prototype of a new invention to solve a specific problem.

days.title: How Tools Changed Us
days.learning_objective: Tools extended human capabilities and transformed civilization.
learning_objectives: Describe the basic function of a wheel and axle.
Identify different applications of wheels in everyday life.
Explain how the invention of the wheel impacted human civilization.

days.title: The Invention of the Wheel
days.learning_objective: The wheel revolutionized transportation and machinery.
learning_objectives: Students will be able to explain the basic mechanics of the printing press.
Students will be able to describe the social and cultural impact of the printing press on Europe and beyond.
Students will be able to compare and contrast pre-printing press and post-printing press societies.

days.title: How Levers Multiply Force
days.learning_objective: Levers use leverage to multiply force and move heavy objects.
learning_objectives: Identify the key components and functions of a telescope.
Explain how telescopes have revolutionized our understanding of the universe.
Compare and contrast different types of telescopes and their uses.

days.title: Lifting Heavy Things Easily
days.learning_objective: Lifting Heavy Things Easily is an important concept that helps us understand our world.
learning_objectives: Identify the major parts of a microscope and explain their functions.
Prepare a wet mount slide and observe microscopic specimens.
Describe the characteristics of different types of microorganisms.
Explain the importance of microscopes in scientific discovery.

days.title: How Gears Transfer Motion
days.learning_objective: Gears transmit motion and change speed or direction.
learning_objectives: Describe the basic principles of how a steam engine works.
Explain the role of the steam engine in the Industrial Revolution.
Identify key figures and innovations associated with steam engine development.
Analyze the social and economic impacts of steam-powered technology.

days.title: What Engines Actually Do
days.learning_objective: Understanding what engines actually do reveals about our world.
learning_objectives: Explain the basic principles of how a light bulb works.
Identify key inventors and milestones in the development of the light bulb.
Describe the impact of the light bulb on society and daily life.

days.title: How Computers Think
days.learning_objective: Understanding how computers think helps us make sense of the world.
learning_objectives: Describe the basic principles of how a telephone works.
Identify key figures in the history of the telephone and their contributions.
Explain the social and cultural impact of the telephone on society.

days.title: What Robots Can Do
days.learning_objective: Understanding what robots can do reveals about our world.
learning_objectives: Identify the four forces of flight: lift, drag, thrust, and weight.
Describe the basic parts of an airplane and their functions.
Explain the history of flight and the contributions of the Wright brothers.

days.title: How AI Learns
days.learning_objective: Artificial intelligence learns patterns from large amounts of data.
learning_objectives: Define what a computer is and its core components.
Explain how computers process information at high speeds.
Identify various applications of computers in everyday life.

days.title: How the Internet Works
days.learning_objective: The internet connects billions of people worldwide.
learning_objectives: Explain the basic structure of the Internet and how it connects devices.
Identify potential online risks and strategies for staying safe online.
Describe the positive and negative impacts of the Internet on society.
